title.suggested: Allen loses a wrestling match to sprinter William Richards

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Post-Dispatch reported that Tom Allen, weighing 245 pounds, lost an impromptu $50-a-side wrestling match at his saloon to champion sprint runner Capt. William Richards, who threw him twice.
